name: znetwork_dplay_enum_sessions
description: zNetwork_DPlay::EnumSessions clears the enumerated-session list, initializes a DirectPlay session descriptor with the app GUID, calls IDirectPlay4::EnumSessions through vtable slot 0x34, and returns the resulting enumerated-session count or error sentinel.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja renders the compiler-emitted app GUID copy as split field assignments; source uses memcpy for the same 16-byte copy.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a220 validates ClearEnumeratedSessionList first, null DirectPlay zero return, zeroed 0x50-byte descriptor, size 0x50, appGuid copy from g_zNetwork_AppGuid, EnumSessions vtable slot 0x34 with timeout 0, callback zNetworkDPlay::EnumSessionCallback_AddSessionDescCache, context 0, flags 2, -1 return for 0x88770118, ReportError line 0xb3 for other failures, and zArchiveList::GetCount success return.

The native smoke verifies null DirectPlay behavior, descriptor appGuid/size and vtable arguments, callback-based list append and count return, list clearing, 0x88770118 return -1, and negative DirectPlay error propagation through ReportError.
